SELECT fish_date_season AS season, cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS share_per_angler,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('THREE_QUARTER','OVERNIGHT','DAY_1_5') AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 240 AND 330
  AND fish_date_season IN (1,2)
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT fish_date_season AS season, cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS share_per_angler,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5') AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 240 AND 330
  AND fish_date_season IN (1,2)
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT avail_season AS season, avail_doy, value
FROM climate
WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season IN (1,2) AND avail_doy BETWEEN 230 AND 300
ORDER BY season, avail_doy
